IC1: Non-compliance [AND] with DOTPlus. Alternatively DOT can be done by telephoning patient on a daily basis 5 times a week and having patient annotate taking drug in a log which would be reviewed by clinic staff
IC2: History of being treated  [OR]for tuberculosis in the prior 2 years unless there is DST, including PCR testing, [AND] showing sensitivity  [AND]to rifamycin.
IC3: Known hypersensitivity to rifampin o [OR]r rifabutin.
IC4: Liver enzymes greater than 2 times ULN.
IC6: Serum creatinine greater than 3 times ULN.
IC7: Hemoglobin less than 7.0 gms even if receiving erythropoietin.
IC8: Absolute neutrophil count less than 750 cells/mm3 even if receiving G-CSF.
IC10: Fasting cholesterol > 1.6 upper limits of normal.
IC11: GI intolerance of tuberc [AND]ulosis medications requiring discontinuation of tuberc [AND]ulosis medications.
IC14: Use of one of the prohibited medications
IC15: Any condition that the investigators feel could compromise the use of the current medication.
IC16: Have a CD4 cell count of 50 cells/mm3or less
IC18: Alcohol or illicit drug  [OR]use, which in the investigators opinion may affect participation in study.
